thread:
maya: :rotating_light: paging: we started seeing p95 latency jump on inference-hosts in us-west-2 ~12:03 UTC, clients reported slow streaming and timeouts. root cause unclear, looks correlated with recent quantization rollout. I'm starting an investigation.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-17. Severity: Sev2. Pager duty: @maya. Playbook: inference-runtime-high-latency.

maya: quick triage notes:
- KV cache hitrate dropped ~30% for long-tail prefixes.
- Batching latency increase observed when sequence lengths >512.
- Canary quant pack rolled at 11:50 UTC to 10% traffic (model v2-q8).

samir: on it — handoff to me in 5m if you need to jump to customer comms. I'll look at rollout logs and autoscale.

ryan: adding observability: enabling debug KV cache counters and sampling traces for affected host pool. Also opening ephemeral metrics dashboard.

maya: mitigation attempt 1: paused quant rollout (traffic -> v2-ptx), started draining canary nodes. Noticed retries spiking on the batching service.

ops-bot: Autoscale event: +8 inference workers in us-west-2 triggered at 12:12 UTC.

samir: hypothesis: quant change changed tokenization alignment for prefix caching, causing cache misses and larger batches -> higher tail latency. Trying quick revert of quant marshalling layer on canary subset.

ryan: confirmed increased KV eviction rate after rollout. Suggest increasing cache size + extend TTL as temporary band-aid.

maya: mitigation 2 (live): increased KV cache capacity by 25% on affected pool, TTL +30s. Reverted quant marshalling on remaining canary nodes. Early signs: p95 down ~180ms at 12:28 UTC.

samir: continuing monitoring. Marking customer-impact as "degraded streaming" for a subset of customers (about 2%). Not a full outage.

maya: good work. I'm handing incident to @samir for overnight watch and postmortem owner nomination. Samir, can you own the postmortem and remediation tracking?

samir: I can own postmortem. Tentative postmortem meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC. I'll create the doc and invite SRE, Runtime, ML infra, and PSG folks.

maya: action items (short-term) — assign owners:
- AT1: Postmortem doc + timeline + initial impact assessment -> samir (due: tomorrow 16:00 UTC)
- AT2: Root-cause deep dive: KV cache keying + tokenization interaction -> ryan (due: +48h)
- AT3: Re-run quant unit tests with prefix-preservation scenarios -> kelly (due: +24h)
- AT4: Add automated canary rollback on latency regression >20% -> samir/eng-runtime (due: +72h)
- AT5: Customer outreach for affected accounts -> maya / success (due: +24h)

ops-bot: Note: remember to file engineering ticket in JIRA with label "runtime-remediation" and link to postmortem.

samir: I've created the postmortem stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4421. Adding tasks and linking logs.

ryan: quick follow-up: will instrument a test harness that simulates tokenization drift with quantized weights; will also push a KV key idempotency check to reduce sensitivity to tokenization changes.

kelly: I'll add regression tests for quant packing that include multi-segment prefixes and edge-case token alignments. Will also add a perf guard in CI to catch batching latency regressions.

maya: final note before sign-off: ops mitigation stable, customers notified. Samir, please post summary in #incidents when postmortem scheduled and include action owners. I'll remove myself from active pager after 2h overlap.

samir: ack. I'll keep the watch till 16:30 UTC and then hand to oncall rotation. Will ping when postmortem time confirmed.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> monitoring. Downtime impact: degraded for subset. Linked ticket: RINF-4421.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
